en.settings.clearConfirmAck: I understand this clears all usage data without rebuilding
en.settings.clearConfirmDesc: Clears all ledger data and resets statistics to zero without rescanning history. This cannot be undone and is used to restart counting. Continue?
en.settings.clearHint: Clear all ledger data (events and session metadata) and reset statistics to zero without rescanning history
en.settings.configCopyFailed: Copy failed — select all in the box above and copy manually
en.settings.configErrorBase64: The config string cannot be parsed; check that the whole string was copied with no line breaks or stray characters
en.settings.configErrorEmpty: Nothing pasted yet — paste a config string first
en.settings.configErrorFormat: This is not a config string from this plugin; check where it came from
en.settings.configErrorPayload: The config string content is corrupted and cannot be restored to preferences
en.settings.configErrorVersion: The config string version does not match this plugin, so it cannot be imported
en.settings.configExportHint: Encode the current preferences into one line of text you can copy to another device or deployment; it holds no credentials and no usage data
en.settings.configImportHint: After you paste a config string and confirm, the current settings are replaced wholesale by the preferences in the string
en.settings.configPreview: This overwrites {count} settings, {fields} of them differ from the current values
en.settings.configPreviewSame: Identical to the current settings, nothing to import
en.settings.configReadonlyHint: The server-side config is read-only right now, so importing is unavailable; exporting still works
en.settings.ledgerBusyHint: A session log scan is in progress; clearing or rebuilding is unavailable until it finishes
en.settings.modelRedirectsDuplicate: The same source already has a rule; only the topmost one applies
en.settings.modelRedirectsEmpty: No redirect yet — the Models tab counts each provider and model separately
en.settings.modelRedirectsHint: Count one provider/model usage under another provider/model; this affects the Models tab and the by-model tables in date/session details, while the ledger keeps its raw data
en.settings.modelRedirectsIncomplete: Takes effect once all four fields are filled
en.settings.monitorHint: Turning monitoring off stops polling that endpoint. "Show in sidebar" only affects the footer chips; the panel always shows the data.
en.settings.rebuildConfirmAck: I understand this clears and rebuilds all usage data
en.settings.rebuildConfirmDesc: Clears the event stream and session metadata, then rescans all historical session logs to rebuild the ledger and statistics. This cannot be undone. Continue?
en.settings.rebuildHint: Clear the event stream and session metadata, then rescan all session logs to rebuild the ledger and statistics
en.settings.redirectPick: Pick from the list or type a value
en.settings.showSessionId: Show session ID next to the session title
en.settings.showSessionIdHint: When off, no session-id badge is shown at the right of the session title
en.settings.storageReadonly: The server-side profile config is read-only right now; changes will not be saved
en.settings.storageUnavailable: This connection cannot read the server-side profile config; changes last only until this page is closed
